subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw preserve the AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-only sub-agent bootstrap boundary and handle MiniMax Token Plan skills through explicit skill/plugin surfaces, or should Token Plan skill inheritance be restored for sub-agents?
rationale: Current source shows the reported bootstrap behavior is intentional and tested, while the Token Plan endpoint failure still needs live vendor proof before changing the MiniMax provider contract.

options.title: Keep the boundary, verify provider behavior
options.body: Preserve the sub-agent bootstrap boundary, live-test MiniMax Token Plan image generation, and fix only a confirmed provider/media delivery defect.

options.title: Approve skill inheritance work
options.body: Explicitly change the sub-agent context contract so selected Token Plan skills can load in child sessions, with security and prompt-budget guardrails.

options.title: Move office automation to ClawHub
options.body: Treat the PPT/Word/Excel/PDF pieces as skill bundle work and ask for a ClawHub package with install docs and smoke proof.

recommendation.title: Keep the boundary, verify provider behavior
recommendation.body: Preserve the sub-agent bootstrap boundary, live-test MiniMax Token Plan image generation, and fix only a confirmed provider/media delivery defect.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available routing owner from recent touched-path history and the issue timeline mentions for this mixed provider/bootstrap decision.
